target.title: fix(gateway): evaluate channel health at startup grace
target.body:
Closes #105668

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway operators with dead or unauthenticated channels would wait a full health-monitor interval (default 5 minutes) after startup before the first automatic recovery evaluation, even though the configured startup grace is only 60 seconds.

## Why This Change Was Made

When startup grace is shorter than the check interval (the production default), the monitor now arms a one-shot evaluation at grace expiry in addition to the existing interval cadence. Interval ticks during grace remain no-ops via the existing `startedAt` gate. Stop/shutdown/abort still clear both timers.

## User Impact

Gateways recover stale/dead channel accounts sooner after process start: first health evaluation runs at startup-grace expiry instead of waiting for the first full interval tick. No config changes.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (real Node process + focused Vitest)

Head refreshed: merged `origin/main` into PR branch (`ce840ad30`); focused suite re-run on refreshed head.

Commands:
```text
git merge origin/main
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.ts src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.test.ts
# real-process (wall-clock timers, not fake timers):
node /tmp/openclaw-pr105725-health-monitor-proof.mjs
```

Results:
- `git diff --check` on touched surface: pass
- focused Vitest on refreshed head: **184 passed** (4 gateway project shards × 46 tests)
- real-process proof: **PASS** — 0 snapshot calls mid-grace; 1 call at +1007ms (~grace); still 1 after stop/dwell
- CS rank-up items addressed this round: (1) real-process terminal transcript for no pre-grace / one at grace / clean stop; (2) head refreshed onto current main + focused revalidation


## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Channel health monitor performs its first post-grace evaluation at startup-grace expiry when grace is shorter than the check interval, instead of waiting for the first full interval tick; stop clears both the one-shot and interval schedule so no lingering evaluation runs after shutdown.
- Environment: local macOS Node 24 real process (not Vitest fake timers). Script imports `startChannelHealthMonitor` from `src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.ts` via tsx loader, arms `startupGraceMs=1000` and `checkIntervalMs=60000`, provides a failing `telegram/default` runtime snapshot (`running=false`, `connected=false`).
- Current-main contrast: On main, only `setInterval(checkIntervalMs)` is armed, so with defaults (60s grace, 5m interval) the first evaluation is delayed until the first full interval tick. On this head, a lifecycle-owned one-shot fires at grace expiry.
- Exact steps after this patch:
  1. Merged current `origin/main` into the PR branch (refreshed head; no force-push).
  2. Ran real-timer Node harness (wall clock): mid-grace at +650ms → 0 snapshot calls; first `getRuntimeSnapshot` at +1007ms; `monitor.stop()`; after-stop dwell +1.5s → still 1 call.
  3. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.test.ts` on refreshed head.
- Evidence after fix (real process transcript, redacted; no secrets):

```text
[+    0ms] startChannelHealthMonitor grace=1000ms interval=60000ms (real timers)
[health-monitor] started (interval: 60s, startup-grace: 1s, channel-connect-grace: 0s)
[+  650ms] mid-grace check: snapshotCalls=0 (expect 0)
[+ 1007ms] getRuntimeSnapshot call #1 (failing channel present: telegram/default running=false connected=false)
[health-monitor] [telegram:default] health-monitor: restarting (reason: stopped)
[+ 1453ms] post-grace check: snapshotCalls=1 (expect 1)
[+ 1454ms] calling monitor.stop() / clean shutdown
[+ 2956ms] after-stop dwell: snapshotCalls=1 (expect still 1)
[+ 2956ms] RESULT: PASS — no pre-grace eval; one at grace; no post-stop eval; callLog=[{"n":1,"atMs":1006}]
```

- Focused Vitest on refreshed head (`ce840ad30`): **184 passed** (4 gateway project shards × 46 tests), including `runs first health check at startup grace without waiting for the full interval`.
- Control check: mid-grace 0 calls; post-stop dwell no extra calls; existing suite cases for pre-grace skip, interval cadence, cooldown, single-flight, and stop/abort cleanup remain green.
- Observed result after fix: First evaluation fires at startup-grace expiry on the real Node event loop when grace < interval; stop clears schedule (no lingering evaluation).
- What was not tested: Live multi-channel managed Gateway install with intentionally dead Telegram/Slack production tokens across a full wall-clock 60s grace / 5m interval boot (shortened grace/interval used for agent-solo real-process proof of the same timer ownership path).

## AI disclosure

This PR was authored with AI assistance (Grok / find-openclaw-issue + fix-openclaw-issue auto pipeline). Human operator did not manually edit the diff.
